highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.152.0 bumps to a Skia m152 build with a use-after-free fix.

bullets.lead: Skia updated with a Chrome m152 UAF fix
bullets.detail: Bumps the bundled Skia engine to pick up an upstream Chrome m152 use-after-free fix.
Updates the .NET SDK and container pins used to build and test SkiaSharp to 10.0.400.
